<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>FirstRun: Docs that work (literally)</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/site-nav.css">
<meta name="description" content="Docs break quietly, and a new user finds out first. Doc-test runs your quickstart in a clean container and proves the fix. Doc-audit finds the pages your code left behind.">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
<script>document.documentElement.className="js"</script>
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:title" content="FirstRun: Docs that work (literally).">
<meta property="og:description" content="Doc-test proves your quickstart works in a clean container. Doc-audit reads git history and finds stale docs pages.">
<meta property="og:image" content="assets/og-card-1200x630.jpg">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<link rel="icon" href="assets/logo.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Geist+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
--bg:oklch(98.7% .003 255);--panel:oklch(99.8% .0015 255);--sunk:oklch(97.1% .005 255);--hover:oklch(96.2% .007 255);
--line:oklch(91.6% .007 255);--ink:oklch(22% .012 255);--mut:oklch(48% .013 255);
--test:oklch(55% .19 256);--test-d:oklch(47% .17 256);--test-bg:oklch(95.6% .026 256);
--audit:oklch(52% .2 295);--audit-d:oklch(45% .18 295);--audit-bg:oklch(95.8% .03 295);
--gold:oklch(72% .14 78);--gold-d:oklch(44% .09 65);--gold-bg:oklch(96.6% .035 85);
--ok:oklch(52% .14 150);--ok-d:oklch(45% .12 150);--ok-bg:oklch(96.4% .032 150);
--bad:oklch(53% .19 27);--bad-bg:oklch(96.6% .02 27);
--sh:0 1px 2px oklch(30% .02 255/.06);
--lift:0 1px 2px oklch(30% .03 256/.05),0 8px 24px -10px oklch(35% .06 256/.16),0 24px 56px -28px oklch(35% .06 256/.18);
--lift-h:0 2px 4px oklch(30% .03 256/.06),0 16px 36px -12px oklch(35% .07 256/.22),0 36px 72px -30px oklch(35% .07 256/.24);
--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);--road:oklch(22% .012 255/.08);
--mono:"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
--pad:clamp(72px,10vw,128px);--link:var(--test-d)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Geist,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);line-height:1.5;font-size:16px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
html,body{overflow-x:clip}
code,pre,.mono{font-family:var(--mono)}
/* every link is underlined. Real buttons look like buttons and carry no underline. */
a{color:var(--link);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:3px}
a:hover{text-decoration-thickness:2px}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--test);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}
img{max-width:100%}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
section{padding:var(--pad) 0 0}
h1{font-size:clamp(36px,5.6vw,64px);line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.045em;font-weight:700}
h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,48px);line-height:1.06;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:700;text-align:center;max-width:17em;margin:0 auto;text-wrap:balance}
h3{letter-spacing:-.025em}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--lift)}
.ic{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;display:inline-block}
/* motion: one fade and rise as a block enters, staggered inside a group */
html.js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .9s var(--ease),transform .9s var(--ease)}
html.js .rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* buttons */
button,.btn{font:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;background:var(--test);color:oklch(99.5% .003 256);border:1px solid var(--test);border-radius:12px;padding:0 22px;cursor:pointer;min-height:46px;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;transition:background .15s,transform .4s var(--ease)}
button:hover,.btn:hover{background:var(--test-d);text-decoration:none}
.btn.au{background:var(--audit);border-color:var(--audit)}.btn.au:hover{background:var(--audit-d)}
.cta{text-align:center;margin-top:40px}

/* hero */
#hero{text-align:center;padding-top:clamp(28px,5vw,64px);position:relative;isolation:isolate}
#hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;left:50%;top:-140px;width:min(1400px,140vw);height:760px;transform:translateX(-50%);pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(34% 42% at 28% 34%,oklch(84% .09 256/.42),transparent 72%),radial-gradient(30% 38% at 74% 28%,oklch(84% .1 295/.34),transparent 72%),radial-gradient(28% 34% at 52% 78%,oklch(90% .08 85/.32),transparent 72%)}
#hero .wrap>*{animation:rise 1s var(--ease) both}#hero .wrap>:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.06s}#hero .wrap>:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.12s}#hero .wrap>:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.18s}#hero .wrap>:nth-child(n+5){animation-delay:.24s}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
#hero h1{max-width:13em;margin:0 auto;text-wrap:balance}
.lede{margin:18px auto 0;font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,21px);line-height:1.45;max-width:30em;color:var(--ink);text-wrap:balance}
.what{margin:8px auto 0;font-size:clamp(16px,1.7vw,18px);color:var(--mut);max-width:32em;text-wrap:balance}
.box{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:32px auto 0;max-width:640px;border-radius:16px;padding:7px 7px 7px 20px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--lift)}
.box:focus-within{border-color:var(--test);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--test-bg),var(--lift)}
.box input{flex:1;min-width:0;font:inherit;font-size:17px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink);padding:10px 0;outline:0}
.box input::placeholder{color:oklch(58% .01 255)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}
.chips .lbl{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;align-self:center;margin-right:2px}
.chips button{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:500;font-size:14px;min-height:34px;padding:0 13px;border-radius:99px}
.chips button:hover{background:var(--hover);color:var(--test-d)}
.hint{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px;min-height:1.45em}
.hint.cached{color:var(--ok-d);font-weight:500}

/* generated prompt */
#out{padding-top:28px}
.hit{padding:20px 22px;margin-bottom:16px}
.hit[hidden],.fresh[hidden]{display:none}
.hit-top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 14px;color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;border-radius:99px;padding:3px 11px;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok-d)}
.pill:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.pill.other{background:var(--test-bg);color:var(--test-d)}
.hit h3{font-size:24px;line-height:1.15;margin-top:10px}
.hit p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:6px;max-width:40em}
.hit-act{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 16px;margin-top:16px}
.hit-act span{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.fresh{font-size:15px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;margin:0 0 8px 4px}
.panel{overflow:hidden}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:6px 8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:flex-end}
.tabs [role=tab]{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);background:none;border:0;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;padding:0 14px;min-height:40px}
.tabs [role=tab]:hover{color:var(--ink);background:none}
.tabs [role=tab][aria-selected=true]{color:var(--test-d);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--test)}
.tabs .sp{flex:1}
.tabs .cp{margin:0 2px 6px 0;min-height:34px;font-size:14px;padding:0 14px}
.how{padding:12px 20px 0;color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
pre{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;padding:8px 20px 20px;max-height:400px;overflow:auto;color:var(--ink)}
.strip{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.strip li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:14px;line-height:1.3;padding:12px 14px}
.strip li .ic{color:var(--test)}
.cli{padding:14px 18px;margin-top:10px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre}
.cli .p,.cli .c{color:var(--mut)}.cli .p{user-select:none}

/* film: full bleed, no frame, edges fade into the page */
#film{padding:clamp(32px,5vw,72px) 0 0}
.reel{position:relative;max-width:1680px;margin:0 auto;aspect-ratio:2/1}
.reel video{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;background:var(--bg);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 9%,#000 91%,transparent),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 11%,#000 89%,transparent);-webkit-mask-composite:source-in;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 9%,#000 91%,transparent),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 11%,#000 89%,transparent);mask-composite:intersect;mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.ctl{position:absolute;right:max(20px,8%);bottom:9%;display:flex;gap:8px}
.ctl button{min-height:36px;padding:0 16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink);background:oklch(99.7% .0015 255/.92);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--lift)}
.ctl button:hover{background:var(--panel)}

/* bands: one full-bleed color world per tool, so a new reader always knows which tool this is.
   A soft glow from the top edge plus a quiet dot field, masked so it fades out. */
.band{position:relative;isolation:isolate;margin-top:var(--pad);padding:var(--pad) 0;background:var(--tint);border-block:1px solid var(--edge);overflow:hidden}
.band+.band{margin-top:0;border-top:0}
.band:before,.band:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}
.band:before{background:radial-gradient(90% 55% at 50% 0%,var(--glow),transparent 70%)}
.band:after{background-image:radial-gradient(circle,var(--dot) 1px,transparent 1.4px);background-size:24px 24px;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(70% 50% at 50% 22%,#000,transparent 78%);mask-image:radial-gradient(70% 50% at 50% 22%,#000,transparent 78%)}
.b-test{--tint:oklch(96.4% .02 250);--glow:oklch(91% .06 252/.85);--dot:oklch(55% .19 256/.16);--edge:oklch(89.5% .04 252);--c:var(--test);--cd:var(--test-d);--link:var(--test-d)}
.b-audit{--tint:oklch(96.5% .022 300);--glow:oklch(91.5% .06 300/.85);--dot:oklch(52% .2 295/.15);--edge:oklch(89.5% .045 300);--c:var(--audit);--cd:var(--audit-d);--link:var(--audit-d)}
.b-rcpt{--tint:oklch(97.3% .026 85);--glow:oklch(93% .07 85/.9);--dot:oklch(60% .12 70/.16);--edge:oklch(90% .05 80);--c:var(--gold);--cd:var(--gold-d);--link:var(--gold-d)}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:18px;font-weight:650;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:var(--cd)}
.tile{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--c);color:oklch(99.5% .003 256);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.tile .ic{width:19px;height:19px}

/* three beats: a broken step, the fix, the proof */
.beats{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(18px,2.6vw,32px);margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,60px);position:relative}
.beat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;min-width:0;position:relative}
.beat+.beat:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:calc(-1 * clamp(18px,2.6vw,32px));top:58px;width:clamp(18px,2.6vw,32px);height:2px;background:var(--edge)}
.bl{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;font-weight:650;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-align:center}
.bn{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 13px/1 var(--mono);background:var(--c);color:oklch(99.5% .003 256)}
.win{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;text-align:left}
.win-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.win-h i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line);display:inline-block}
.win-h span{margin-left:6px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.win-b{padding:16px 16px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font:500 14px/1.45 var(--mono);flex:1}
.ln{padding:5px 9px;border-radius:7px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.ln.cmd:before{content:"$ ";color:var(--mut)}
.ln.err{background:var(--bad-bg);color:var(--bad)}
.ln.del{background:var(--bad-bg);color:var(--bad);text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.ln.del:before{content:"\2212  ";text-decoration:none;display:inline-block;width:1.4em}
.ln.add{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok-d)}
.ln.add:before{content:"+  ";display:inline-block;width:1.4em}
.ln.note{font-family:Geist,sans-serif;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut);padding:2px 9px}
.pass{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex:1;padding:6px 0}
.pass b{font:700 clamp(26px,2.8vw,32px)/1 Geist,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:var(--ok-d)}
.dots{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:6px;max-width:220px}
.dots i{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok);display:grid;place-items:center}
.dots i:after{content:"";width:6px;height:3.5px;border:solid oklch(99.5% .003 150);border-width:0 0 1.8px 1.8px;transform:translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg)}
.src{text-align:center;margin-top:26px;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}

/* the number line: plain sentences with the numbers set large */
.tally{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:12px clamp(28px,5vw,64px);margin-top:clamp(56px,7vw,88px);text-align:center}
.tally p{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:16px;color:var(--mut)}
.tally b{font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,72px);line-height:1;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:var(--cd);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* PR carousel */
.prs{margin-top:clamp(28px,4vw,40px)}
.track{display:flex;gap:20px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-padding:0 24px;padding:16px 24px 32px;margin:0 -24px;scrollbar-width:none;overscroll-behavior-x:contain}
.track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.track>:first-child{margin-left:auto}.track>:last-child{margin-right:auto}
.pr{flex:0 0 min(330px,82vw);scroll-snap-align:start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;text-align:left;transition:transform .6s var(--ease),box-shadow .6s var(--ease)}
.pr:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--lift-h)}
.cover{display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.cover img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top left;display:block}
.cover.ty{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:2px;padding:16px 18px;background:var(--test-bg);text-decoration:none;color:var(--test-d)}
.cover.ty b{font-size:44px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.05em}
.cover.ty span{font:500 13px var(--mono);color:var(--mut)}
.pr-b{padding:16px 18px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1}
.pr-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.repo{font:500 12.5px/1.2 var(--mono);color:var(--mut);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}
.st{margin-left:auto;font-weight:600;font-size:12px;border-radius:99px;padding:2px 9px 2px 8px;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok-d);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex:none;text-transform:capitalize}
.st:before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.st.merged{background:var(--audit-bg);color:var(--audit-d)}
.st.closed{background:var(--sunk);color:var(--mut)}
.pr h3{font-size:17px;line-height:1.3}
.pr h3 a{color:var(--ink)}
.pr h3 a:hover{color:var(--test-d)}

.found{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1;justify-content:center}

.board{display:block;max-width:940px;margin:clamp(40px,5vw,56px) auto 0;padding:10px;text-decoration:none}

/* receipt */
.rc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,380px) minmax(0,360px);justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:clamp(32px,6vw,80px);margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,60px)}
.rw{filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px oklch(40% .05 70/.10)) drop-shadow(0 18px 30px oklch(40% .06 70/.18))}

-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) top/100% calc(100% - 9px) no-repeat,conic-gradient(from -45deg at bottom,#0000,#000 1deg 89deg,#0000 90deg) bottom/18px 9px repeat-x;
mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) top/100% calc(100% - 9px) no-repeat,conic-gradient(from -45deg at bottom,#0000,#000 1deg 89deg,#0000 90deg) bottom/18px 9px repeat-x}

.bar{grid-column:2/4;height:7px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--gold-bg);overflow:hidden;margin-top:-2px}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:96.4%;border-radius:99px;background:var(--gold)}
.r-sub{grid-column:2/4;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:-4px}
.stamp{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;font:700 13px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ok-d);border:2px solid var(--ok);border-radius:6px;padding:7px 10px;transform:rotate(-4deg)}
.r-foot{text-align:center}
.keys{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:26px;text-align:left}

.keys .mk{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:15px}
.keys b{display:block;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.15}
.keys span{color:var(--mut);font-size:16px}
.rlinks{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:10px 32px;margin-top:clamp(36px,5vw,52px);font-weight:600}

/* watch it work: three YouTube videos behind a click-to-load facade */
.vids{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:44px}
.vc{display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .6s var(--ease),box-shadow .6s var(--ease)}

.vc.big{grid-row:1/3}

.vp{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;color:var(--ink);border-radius:0}
.vp:focus-visible{outline-offset:-4px;border-radius:0}
.pi{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:64px;height:64px;margin:-32px 0 0 -32px;border-radius:50%;background:oklch(99.7% .0015 255/.94);color:var(--test);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:var(--lift);transition:transform .5s var(--ease),background .2s,color .2s}
.pi svg{width:24px;height:24px;margin-left:4px}
.vc.big .pi{width:84px;height:84px;margin:-42px 0 0 -42px}.vc.big .pi svg{width:30px;height:30px}

.vt{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:14px 18px 16px}
.vt h3{font-size:16px;line-height:1.25}
.vc.big .vt{padding:20px 24px 22px;gap:6px}
.vc.big .vt h3{font-size:clamp(19px,2vw,23px)}
.vt p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;max-width:44em}
.vt .k{font:600 11px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}

/* tools: a logo row, one line each */
.tools{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:28px clamp(32px,6vw,72px);margin-top:44px}
.tools li{flex:0 1 250px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;text-align:center}
.tools img{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh);background:var(--panel)}
.tools b{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin-top:4px}
.tools span{color:var(--mut);font-size:15px;line-height:1.45}
.tools a{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}

/* comparison, light */
.cmp-s{overflow-x:auto;margin-top:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}

.cmp th,.cmp td{padding:13px 14px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

.cmp thead th .ci{width:20px;height:20px;vertical-align:-5px;margin-right:7px}
.cmp thead th.me{color:var(--test-d)}
.cmp tbody th{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);width:19%}
.cmp td{color:var(--mut)}

.cmp td.me{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.cell{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}
.mk2{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:1px;fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.mk2.y{stroke:var(--ok)}.mk2.y circle{fill:var(--ok-bg);stroke:none}
.mk2.n{stroke:var(--mut)}.mk2.n circle{fill:var(--sunk);stroke:none}

/* build log */

.trk .edge{fill:none;stroke:oklch(99.7% .0015 255/.8);stroke-width:20;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.trk .mid{fill:none;stroke:var(--panel);stroke-width:2.5;stroke-dasharray:1 9;stroke-linecap:round}
.trk .done{fill:none;stroke:var(--test);stroke-width:3.5;stroke-linecap:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px oklch(55% .19 256/.5))}
.trk .pt{fill:var(--panel);stroke:var(--test);stroke-width:3}
.trk .pt.next{stroke:oklch(68% .01 255)}
.tl{list-style:none;padding:0 clamp(36px,6vw,72px);margin:0;position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-flow:row dense;column-gap:clamp(20px,3.5vw,44px);row-gap:clamp(24px,3.5vw,40px)}

.tl li:nth-child(4n+4){grid-column:1}

.post{margin:0;padding:16px 18px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--lift);max-width:550px}
.post p{margin:0 0 .4em}.post a{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.tw.vid{width:fit-content;max-width:100%;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px oklch(80% .15 85/.9),0 0 26px 3px oklch(84% .16 85/.5),0 0 64px 8px oklch(87% .15 85/.28);animation:aura 3.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes aura{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px oklch(80% .15 85),0 0 34px 6px oklch(84% .16 85/.62),0 0 84px 14px oklch(87% .15 85/.36)}}
.followx{font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.twitter-tweet-rendered{margin:0!important}

/* about */
.about{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:16px;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,40px);max-width:680px;margin:0 auto}
.about img{width:120px;height:120px;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;border-radius:50%;display:block}
.about h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,30px)}
.about p{color:var(--mut);font-size:16px;max-width:34em}
.links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:6px 22px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
footer{max-width:1080px;margin:var(--pad) auto 0;padding:24px 24px 44px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 24px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
footer .wm{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink)}
footer .wm svg{width:22px;height:22px}
footer nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 18px}

 .beats{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);max-width:460px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}

<p class="lede">Docs break quietly. The first person to find out is a new user, and that user leaves.</p>
<p class="what">FirstRun runs your docs on a clean machine, fixes the step that breaks, and proves the fix.</p>

"""Full-page headless screenshot, then cut into slices for review.
usage: shoot.py <name> <width> <height> [slice]"""
import subprocess, sys, os
from PIL import Image

CH = r"C:\Users\AtharvaShah\AppData\Local\ms-playwright\chromium-1234\chrome-win64\chrome.exe"
OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "shots")

name, w, h = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
sl = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 1100
url = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else "http://localhost:8763/"
p = os.path.join(OUT, name + ".png")
subprocess.run([CH, "--headless=new", "--disable-gpu", "--hide-scrollbars", f"--window-size={w},{h}",

    q = os.path.join(OUT, f"{name}-{i:02d}.png")
    part.save(q)
    print(q)
    i += 1

content.text:
The homepage redesign is committed on `worktree-agent-a13d6b9d9cbb51220` as `4afebff`, not pushed. Every check passed at 1280, 768 and 375 px. There is no sideways scroll and no console errors. All 38 visible content links are underlined, all 8 H2s are centered, and no H2 has a subtitle. The carousel worked with 4 cards and with a temporary 17-card file, which I removed after the test.

**Files changed**
- `D:\Atharva\firstrun\.claude\worktrees\agent-a13d6b9d9cbb51220\docs\index.html` (rewritten)
- `D:\Atharva\firstrun\.claude\worktrees\agent-a13d6b9d9cbb51220\docs\data\prs.json` (new, the 4 real PRs; `gh` showed all 4 open)

I did not touch `receipt.py`, `docs/receipts/*`, `doc-test/` or `doc-audit/`.

## Sections and copy

**0. Hero.** The paste-a-URL tool works as before: saved-run lookup, the prompt for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, and the chips.
- H1: "Find the Broken Step Before Your Users Do"
- Problem line: "Docs break quietly. The first person to find out is a new user, and that user leaves."
- What line: "FirstRun runs your docs on a clean machine, fixes the step that breaks, and proves the fix."
- The button now says "Test my docs" (was "Generate").
- The two app tiles are gone because they mixed Doc-test and Doc-audit.

The film section follows, unchanged.

**1. Doc-test** (`#steps`, blue band)
- H2: "FirstRun Runs Your Quickstart Like a Brand-New User"
- Three beats from the real dbt run:
  1. `jafgen --years 6` fails with `No such option: --years`.
  2. A diff to `jafgen 6`.
  3. "9 of 9 steps passed" with 9 check dots.
- A "Replay this run" link.
- Two numbers: "36 quickstarts tested in a clean container" and "4 fixes sent to real projects".
- The PR carousel (`#proof`), then one button: "Test your docs". It scrolls up and focuses the URL box.

**2. Doc-audit** (`#audit`, purple band)
- H2: "Find the Pages Your Code Left Behind"
- Three beats:
  1. `dbt-labs/dbt-core` in an input.
  2. The "Project flags" page, last edited Jul 2025, with 29 code changes since. One real commit is shown ("normalize project flag keys to uppercase", Jul 2, 2026).
  3. "15 stale pages" and "72 features with no docs".
- The real board screenshot, linked to `./doc-audit/?id=audit-20261010-163620-dbt-labs-dbt-core`.
- Numbers: "7 repos audited" and "102 stale pages found". One button: "Audit a repo".

**3. Receipt** (`#receipt`, warm gold band)
- H2: "Every Run Ends With a Receipt"
- A small receipt in HTML/CSS: help.accuknox.com/knoxctl, model cost $0.0453, Team plan cap $0.04697 with a 96.4% bar, clean rerun 5 of 5, and a "Verified" stamp.
- Three numbered labels: Priced, Capped, Proven.
- Underlined links to the sample receipt HTML and to `plan/`. `plan/` already has the cash chart.

**4. The rest**
- Watch: H2 unchanged, subtitle removed, and the labels now say Doc-test and Doc-audit.
- Tools: H2 "Each Tool Caught a Real Problem in FirstRun". It is now a logo row for neatlogs, Entire and cfo.ai, with one line and one link each.
- Compare: subtitle and row icons removed. It has no card shadow now, and the cell wording is simpler.
- Build log: centered H2, subtitle removed. The race track and the gold aura on the video post still work.
- About: centered, with underlined links. Footer links are underlined too.

## Where the numbers come from
All of them update at runtime. The numbers in the HTML match the data today.
- **36:** the count of distinct docs page URLs in `docs/runs/index.json`, leaving out test fixtures.
- **4:** the length of `docs/data/prs.json`.
- **7 and 102:** the number of audits in `docs/audits/index.json` and the sum of their `stale` field.
- **dbt-core beats** (15, 72, 1,405, 29 changes, Jul 2025): from `audit-20261010-163620-dbt-labs-dbt-core.json`.
- **Receipt figures:** from `FR-20261010-091740-help-accuknox-com.json`.

## Where I went off your brief
- **"68 quickstarts tested" would be wrong.** `runs/index.json` has 68 runs, but 12 are test fixtures and many pages ran more than once. The honest count is 36 different docs pages, so the page says 36.
- **No "16 fixed" or "8 work as written" anywhere on the homepage**, as the coordinator asked.
- **`prs.json` has two optional extra fields: `shot` and `replay`.** The page shows a screenshot only when `shot` is set. A card without one gets a typographic cover with the PR number and docs host. The carousel shows a "1 of 4" style count and has no auto-rotate.
- **The site nav uses old ids.** "How it works" now points to the Doc-test band (`#steps`) and "Proof" points to the carousel (`#proof`). I kept those ids so I did not have to edit the shared `site-nav.js`.

## Dropped and why
- **The 16 / 8 / 4 / 7 / 102 / $0.02 strip:** the hero-metric template, and it mixed both tools.
- **The plan arc and the cash chart with its table:** jargon such as p95, Scenarios and drivers. The chart already lives on `plan/`.
- **The three step screenshots and the annotated Doc-audit pins:** replaced by the beats.
- **The replay and audit link lists**, plus the Entire session link.
- **The tool screenshot modal**, with its commit hashes and trace details.
- **The external GitHub avatar images** on the PR cards.

## Still open
- **The nav dropdown says "16 fixes proven".** That text is in the shared `site-nav.js`, which I did not touch.
- **The compare table hard-codes "4 upstream docs PRs, all open".** It will go stale if a PR changes state.
- **About keeps its bio paragraph under the "Atharva Shah" H2.** It is body text, not a subtitle.
- **`PRODUCT.md` exists only in the main checkout**, not in the worktree. I read it from there.
- **The X embeds did not render in headless Chromium.** Their text fallback showed instead, and they were not checked in a real browser.

## How I checked
- **Tool change:** the browser pane did not paint frames, so it could not take screenshots or run the carousel. I used Playwright's headless Chromium over the DevTools protocol instead.
- **Tests that passed:**
  - The hero URL tool, including saved-run lookup and the prompt.
  - The CTA focusing the URL box.
  - The carousel's next button, arrow keys, end state and count with 17 cards.
  - The empty state when `prs.json` is blocked.
  - Overflow, underline and H2 checks at all three widths.
- **Screenshots:** in `C:\Users\ATHARV~1\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\D--Atharva-firstrun\8af02350-7a0b-4c1e-859f-73dd272ab4c3\scratchpad\shots\`:
  - Full page in slices: `desk-*.png` (1280) and `phone-*.png` (375).
  - Sections: `d-steps.png`, `d-audit.png`, `d-receipt.png` (1280) and `t-steps.png`, `t-receipt.png` (768).
  - Carousel with 17 cards: `c17-desk.png`, `c17-mid.png`.

The AccuKnox/agentz-website clone worked. I read only its CSS and took two ideas: a soft glow from the top of each band and a faded dot-grid texture.
